messages.subject: multiple submit button not working. Is this an Rapache problem?
parts:
Hi Rapache users.
I have been using Rapache since few months and pretty happy with this.
I came across very basic problem while trying to create multiple
submit buttons. The code below creates 3 buttons. First time when the
page loads, all three button works as desired. When I press a button
a new page opens up.

Now when I try to click other buttons, nothing happens.

When I click some other links on the current page and move to some
other page and use back button to come to the original page, those
button starts working again.

I am confused what is going on here. I wrote exactly the same code in
php, and it works as desired.
I am attaching both the codes below.
Thanks.


R code
------------



filenames = c("file1.txt", "file2.txt", "file3.txt")
namesToshow = c("file1", "file2", "file3")
numfiles = length(filenames)

for (i in 1: numfiles)
{
fn1 = filenames[i]
cat('<form enctype=multipart/form-data method=GET
action="processFile.php" target="_blank" >')
cat(paste('<input type="hidden" name="filetoview" value=', fn1, '>',
sep=''))
cat(paste('<input type="submit" style="height: 25px; width: 200px"
value="', namesToshow[i],'">'))
}



Php code
--------------


<?php
$filenames = array("file1.txt", "file2.txt", "file3.txt");
$namesToshow = array("file1", "file2", "file3");
$numfiles = count($filenames);

for ($i = 0; $i< $numfiles; $i++)
{
echo"<form method=GET action='viewResult.php' target='_blank' >";
echo"<input type='hidden' name='filetoview' value= $filenames[$i] >";
echo"<input type='submit' value= $namesToshow[$i] >";
echo'</FORM>';
}
?>
